title: Tobacco refuse

review.classification: Frozen June 2025 document p. 200 and October 2026 CPC3 row 1876 identify tobacco refuse, with the later document pointing to HS 2401.30. The material descriptions in HQ 961890 corroborate uncut unground flue-cured stems. Its holding instead addresses actual-use proof. CBP NY N026926 dealt with a submitted, dried cigar-leaf midrib sample. HQ H185715 held the distinct puffed material in 2403.99.60. These original rulings do not impose a generic length, tax treatment or use condition on all FCV stem consignments.
review.primary_evidence: Stalwart identifies separate long/short FCV grades. The GLTCL portfolio distinguishes stem, scrap and further-processed products. DIMON in its 2004 Form 10-K independently describes redrying and separately packing stems. No one source proves the site, processing and first-release chain for a specific study lot. Only an identifiable provider handoff and a verified receiver specification support use of the method.
review.measurement: Net fresh-release stem mass at measured moisture and actual total dry matter each have their own evidence. Do not treat moisture as a second product or standardize using a guessed fraction. New releases include qualifying unsold stock. Historic finished stock, later services, reinspection and returned articles keep their own cohort. Verify raw/WIP and finished stock closure and independently attributed exchange vectors at source and foreground interfaces. Assign exclusive operations directly, test exchange-specific causality for joint operations and use justified common-gate economic shares only for residual burdens. Follow actual carton and liner receipts, loans, true returns and final dispositions separately.
review.native_records: Tap water is a supplied Product/Mass, conditional on the actual supply for cleaning. The ordinary H2O air release has an Elementary/Mass identity, with unspecified air compartment, and requires a measured basis. Metered electricity uses the Energy property and 1 kWh = 3.6 MJ. Neither the electricity supply identity nor the long-stem reference Product is assumed. Independent public reads of raw tobacco, cured stripped leaves and tobacco dust are incompatible counterexamples.
review.readiness: The four final author files contain 28 atomic cards per language, two conditional flow identities and 26 unresolved identities. The author restored the Energy property on both Chinese metering cards before final submission. Independent pcr:check performed 143 checks, skipped zero and emitted 20 nonblocking warnings. Candidate/authored; Chinese aligned. Scientific and formal translation approvals remain pending.

sources.role: HQ 961890, flue-cured stem description in the analysis. The actual holding concerns evidence of actual use and its time limits.
NY N026926, specific dried uncut cigar-leaf midribs. The sample and its dimensions cannot stand in for FCV.
HQ H185715, final decision for a puffed article; limits on extending the ordinary stem case.
HMRC descriptions of tobacco stems and refuse.
Producer distinguishes long/short FCV midribs and their actual market forms.
Merchant distinguishes stem grades, leaf and further-processed forms.
DIMON company 2004 Form 10-K, Item 1, processing: redrying and separate packing of stems. Several tobacco families and forms are covered.
